Ktesiphon.et: From Ancient Greek Κτησιφῶν (Ktēsiphôn), in part through Latin Ctēsiphōn.

s: In K-Town, tief in Western-Germany, / Zwischen Automarkt und Straßenstrich, in der Prärie
K-Town.et: American English K-Town, originally US military slang, Kaiserslautern being close to the Ramstein Air Base.
